Dear Taylor Morgan, 
On behalf of Meridian Systems, Inc., I am pleased to offer you the position of Senior Product Manager
on our Payments Platform team. Meridian Systems is a publicly traded company listed on the NYSE. 
This is a full-time role based in our New York, NY office. We follow a hybrid model with three days per
week in the office. 
Your compensation package is summarized below. 
Base salary $205,000 per year
Annual bonus target 15% of base salary
Sign-on bonus $30,000 (one-time)
RSUs $280,000 target value, 4-year vesting
Relocation $15,000 
Your annual base salary will be $205,000, paid bi-weekly. 
You will be eligible for an annual bonus with a target of 15% of your base salary. You will also receive a
one-time sign-on bonus of $30,000, payable in your first paycheck. 
You will be granted restricted stock units (RSUs) with a target value of $280,000, vesting over four
years in equal quarterly installments. 
To help with your move, we will provide a relocation package of $15,000. 
Benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with a 5% company match, 20
weeks of paid parental leave, and a $100 monthly commuter benefit. You will receive 25 days of paid
time off per year. 
Your start date will be January 5, 2027. 
Please confirm your acceptance by November 14, 2026. We look forward to welcoming you to Meridian. 
Warm regards,
Dana Whitfield, VP of Product, Meridian Systems, Inc.
